title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their holdings’ estimated $81,500 cost basis
summary: US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded about $635 million in net outflows Thursday as the cryptocurrency traded near the estimated cost basis of the funds' Bitcoin holdings.
